title: Tool Clamp Pressure — Below Minimum
description: Tool clamp pressure P021 = {val} bar, below minimum safe value (55 bar). Tool change aborted. Risk of tool ejection if machining continues.
probable_cause: Pneumatic supply pressure drop, clamp valve leakage, or draw-bar spring fatigue.
diagnostic_steps: Check pneumatic supply pressure at machine entry
Inspect clamp solenoid valve for leakage
Measure draw-bar pull force with tool pull gauge
remedy: Restore pneumatic pressure. Replace draw-bar spring if pull force <12 kN. Do not machine until clamp pressure verified.
required_action: Stop current operation. Machine must be inspected before resuming production.
escalation_path: If TCS-MJ-001 is not addressed (stop current operation. machine must be inspected before resuming production.), the fault will escalate in this order: TCS-CR-001, then HYD-SR-001, then TCS-SR-001. Each subsequent code represents a more severe fault state requiring more urgent intervention. Query each related code for its specific thresholds and required actions.
